create.name: Joseph Selbie
create.bio:
Joseph Selbie, also known by his spiritual name Puru, is an American writer and teacher who has practised Kriya yoga meditation for more than fifty years. In 1975 he was among the founding members of Ananda, the community and movement inspired by Paramhansa Yogananda, where he served as a teacher and minister and studied for decades with Swami Kriyananda, a direct disciple of Yogananda. He also took science courses, including physics and microbiology, at the University of Colorado, and for many years ran a web design firm before retiring to write.

His books try to show where current science and the experience of mystics meet: The Physics of God sets modern physics alongside religious teaching, Break Through the Limits of the Brain looks at neuroscience and spiritual experience, and The Yugas, written with David Steinmetz, explores the Indian teaching of cyclical ages as Yogananda's teacher Sri Yukteswar explained it. He has taught yoga, meditation and non-sectarian spirituality across the United States and Europe, speaks at Yogananda gatherings and conferences on ancient knowledge, and now teaches mainly through online classes, recorded talks and interviews, and his website, where he also shares a free guide to the Hong Sau concentration technique.

books.title: The Physics of God
books.author: Joseph Selbie
books.description: Sets the deepest ideas of modern physics beside the teachings of the world's mystics, arguing that each helps to explain the other. The second edition has a foreword by Amit Goswami.

books.title: Break Through the Limits of the Brain
books.author: Joseph Selbie
books.description: Combines accounts of unusual human abilities with neuroscience and practical exercises, suggesting that meditation can retrain the brain towards spiritual experience. Foreword by Andrew Newberg.

books.title: The Yugas
books.author: Joseph Selbie and David Steinmetz
books.description: Co-written with David Steinmetz, a study of Sri Yukteswar's account of the great ages of history and what it suggests about the past and the age now beginning. Foreword by Swami Kriyananda.

free_resources.title: How to Meditate–The Hong Sau Technique of Concentration
free_resources.description: A free written guide on his website to the Hong Sau concentration technique taught in Yogananda's line, for people starting a daily practice.
